covers: the packet's fourth outcome: a bundle of a genuinely INCOMPLETE evaluation verifies as a valid, complete BUNDLE with no live path of any kind still on disk
registry: fixture-check-registry.json, generated into this case's OWN fixture root
note: This case generates its own fixture tree (plugins, scope, candidates, registry) and DELETES it before verifying, so no other case can be run against a damaged fixture. The bundle is copied away from the run directory first, so the run's own files are not what answers.

incompleteness.why: the fixture registry trim carries checks whose adapter kind is mcp-only / manual / unsupported, so no fixture run can reach evaluation.complete true (EXPECTED.md section 0). D7: an evaluation that is merely incomplete (checks not run) is unchanged: disposition, exit 0.

afterDeletingEverySourcePath.verifyBundleOn: a COPY of the bundle at a different path

expect.rule: D8: verify-bundle reads NOTHING outside the bundle. verify.json carries bundle {schemaSupported, structurallyValid, complete, verified, missing, mismatched, defects} and evaluation {complete, claim, missing} READ FROM THE BUNDLE'S DISPOSITION, not recomputed. Exit 0 only when bundle.complete; a structurally valid bundle of an incomplete evaluation exits 0 — two states, both written. No plugin or asset binary is ever required or copied.

requiredSet.rule: D7: the manifest gains required: [paths] = the six control files, the registry copy, the scope copy when the plan had one, every terminal-ok receipt, every accepted receipt's outputs, and every accepted decision's evidence

unassessedMedia.why: the unassessed-media accounting is unchanged by D7/D8 (`Media rules unchanged; unassessed media stays unassessed`) and is measured by the houseCARL integration module's case-10, which drives a matched and an unmatched media item through evalcontrol bundle --media. Re-fixturing it here would duplicate case-10's arm without adding a boundary.
